highlights: Switching between paired machines no longer marks the left-behind session closed or crashed: the client says goodbye with a new detach request and the session stays registered and resumable
fixes: Legacy pairings that recorded the invite address as the device name (e.g. 192.168.1.108:7644) learn the peer's real name from the handshake; user-chosen names are never overwritten
Old servers that predate the detach request degrade gracefully: the unknown request only draws a benign error event and the connection closes normally
